result.title: RxnMiner: A Multimodal Agent for Structured Reaction Data Extraction from Chemistry Figures
result.comment: 54 pages, 4 figures in the main text. Homepage: https://rxnminer.github.io/RxnMiner/ ; Code: https://github.com/rxnminer/RxnMiner ; Benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UniParser/RxnMiner-Benchmark ; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UniParser/RxnMiner-Dataset
result.summary: Reaction data underpin machine learning for reaction prediction, condition recommendation, and retrosynthetic planning, yet extracting these data from literature figures still requires substantial manual effort. Many figures encode multiple experiments through shared templates, substituent tables, and product grids. Recovering concrete reaction records therefore requires molecular recognition, association of evidence with individual experimental entries, and reconstruction of indirectly specified participants. We present RxnMiner, a multimodal agent system that combines an expert-informed extraction procedure with a chemistry toolbox to coordinate these operations. The agent reads molecular structures, resolves shared and entry-specific evidence, and instantiates participants from templates to assemble source-linked reaction records. We also introduce ChemRxn-Bench, a benchmark of 603 reaction figures with 8,547 manually annotated and reviewed reaction records, evaluated under a common protocol for exact molecular identity and reactant-product pairing. On this benchmark, with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as the backbone, RxnMiner raises stereochemistry-aware reaction macro-F1 from 21.0% under direct prediction to 71.0%, compared with 25.0% for the strongest existing extraction system. Across five backbones, it also outperforms the same base agent without the extraction procedure and chemistry toolbox by 9.4 to 25.5 points. Applied without human intervention to 10,107 literature figures, RxnMiner produces a silver corpus of 88,202 source-linked reaction records.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RxnMiner，一个结合专家式抽取流程与化学工具箱的多模态 agent，从化学反应图中识别分子结构、把共享模板与条目级证据对应起来、按模板重建隐含的反应参与者，并构建 ChemRxn-Bench（603 张图、8,547 条人工标注记录）以精确分子身份和反应物-产物配对为协议评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉证据与单个实验条目绑定」及「由模板实例化补全未直接给出的参与者」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息重建提供问题表述线索，但该工作是化学结构化抽取应用，未涉及内部 latent 状态，迁移价值需核查。
